I diagnosed the problem class and produced a **verified, self-contained solution** at `/workspace/SOLUTION.md`, backed by a runnable reproduction at `/workspace/dockergen-refactor`.

## What was done

**No repository existed** in the environment (only `/workspace/problem.json`), so I built a faithful, compilable reproduction of the described structure and executed the winning methodology end-to-end.

### Root cause
Manager dispatch was duplicated across five hand-maintained structures (`consts`, `Valid()` switch, token policy, `render` switch, `wire` map). No single source of truth meant drift and no completeness validation.

### The fix (golden-first)
Three git tags prove the sequence:

| Tag | Content |
|-----|---------|
| `pre-refactor` | The hardcoded multi-file implementation |
| `golden-proof` | Golden test + frozen `testdata/dockerfiles.golden` (passes pre-refactor) |
| `registry-refactor` | Table-driven `ManagerDef` registry (golden unchanged) |

The refactor replaces all five structures with one `registry.go`:
- `ManagerDef{Name, TokenExtra, TokenDeny, Render, Probe}`
- `register()` refuses empty name, missing `Render`, and duplicates — and derives `Probe` from the row's token policy
- `Valid`, `validateToken`, `render` all read the same map

### Verification (all actually executed)
- Golden passes on the pre-refactor tree via a worktree.
- Golden passes byte-for-byte after refactor: **identical SHA-256** `17924ca1…48446`.
- Exported API diff shows **only** the intentional new `ManagerDef` type; all pre-existing symbols (`Apt/Npm/Pip/Cargo`, `Valid`, `Step`, `Render`, `BuildDockerfile`) are unchanged.
- Registry guard tests (`TestRegisterRejectsBadRows`, `TestRegisterDerivesProbe`) pass.

The markdown includes the full pre-refactor code, the golden test, the complete refactored `registry.go`, guard tests, exact reproduction commands, and a takeaways section — directly usable.
